required_shots.tip: Show any peeling, cracks or stains.
required_shots.hint: A close-up of the paint condition: peeling, cracks, stains or the current finish.

required_shots.prompt: Show the trim, doors or ceiling to paint
required_shots.hint: Trim, doors, ceiling or other surfaces that are part of the job.

questions.q: How much is there to paint?

severity_guide: a room, or a wall with some prep (filling cracks, scraping)
several rooms, or a lot of prep and repair
large exterior or whole-home work, or damaged surfaces needing repair first

policy.finding_wording: Painting work as shown, on-site quote recommended.
rules: affected_area_m2 is the total surface to paint; estimate from doors (about 2 x 0.8 m) and ceiling height (about 2.4 m).
